provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: SHAPIRO_3 cross-line issue: the x pass assigns VAR only for I in 1+Nghost..M-Nghost and MASK==1 (L495-506), but the y pass reads VAR(I,J) and VAR(I,J+-k) for all I=1,M and MASK(I,J)==1 (L515-524) - VAR at ghost columns I<=Nghost or I>M-Nghost, and at cells whose neighbors were masked in x, is read uninitialized.
audit_member_text: SHAPIRO_3 use-before-assign: VAR is declared without initialization at L488 and the x pass assigns it only for wet cells and I=1+Nghost..M-Nghost at L495-L510. The y pass spans every I=1..M and reads VAR at L518-L524 whenever the current MASK is wet, including x-boundary cells never written and neighbor cells skipped as dry; multiplying an undefined neighbor by a zero mask does not make the undefined read valid.

base_member_text: wall_time_secs approximates elapsed seconds by months*mscale where mscale is the length of a single month chosen by the current month (L459-470, formula L472-473), and the leap test is only years divisible by 4 (L466) - approximate by construction.
audit_member_text: Calendar conversion is non-monotonic and omits the year: wall_time_secs reads years at L457 only to choose February length at L466, then computes tcurrent from month*current_month_length plus day/time at L472-L473. It neither accumulates preceding months with their actual lengths nor includes years, causing discontinuities and collisions across month/year boundaries; the leap-year test also ignores century rules.

base_member_text: CHECK_BLOWUP header comment says threshold was changed to 100*max_depth (L391) but the code compares against EtaBlowVal from GLOBAL (L409); where EtaBlowVal is set to 100*max depth is not in this file.
ESTIMATE_DT uses TMP1/TMP2/TMP3, LARGE, SMALL, GRAV, MPI_SP without local declaration (L239-281) - they come from USE PARAM/GLOBAL (L217-220), definitions external to this file.

INDEX under PARALLEL uses iista/iiend/jjsta/jjend (L132-136) which are not declared locally - assumed from GLOBAL; myidi/myidj are set only inside the myid==icp match (L108-110) before use at L132-133.
MAX_MIN_PROPERTY declares MaxAbsEta (L313) but never uses it in this subroutine (L307-383).

audit_member_text: Invalid post-finalize control flow: when nprocs /= px*py, INDEX calls MPI_FINALIZE at L89 but neither stops nor returns; execution then reaches MPI_CART_CREATE and MPI_CART_COORDS at L93-L95 on a finalized MPI runtime.

MPI communicator/rank interface mismatch: MPI_CART_CREATE permits rank reordering through global reorder at L93-L94, but L95 passes world-rank myid directly to MPI_CART_COORDS for comm2d. If reorder is true, coordinates and all downstream myidi/myidj and neighbor assignments can be associated with the wrong rank.

Range/initialization coupling in ESTIMATE_DT: the CFL scan covers all M,N cells including ghost cells at L240-L275 rather than Ibeg:Iend/Jbeg:Jend. Any uninitialized or stale halo H/U/V can spuriously reduce TMP3 and DT; no interface precondition states that all ghost cells are valid before this call.

Nonpositive-step failure: FIXED_DT is copied at L285 and only halved while greater than DT_tmp at L286-L288; a zero or negative DT_fixed passes unchanged, and TIME=TIME+DT at L294 can stall or reverse the outer time loop. No positivity check is present.

Arrival-time sentinel collision: L350 uses ARRTIME==0 as 'not recorded' and L351 stores TIME. A genuine first arrival at TIME=0 stores the sentinel value again, so later calls can overwrite the true arrival time.

NaN can defeat the blow-up test: CHECK_BLOWUP reduces MAXVAL(abs(Eta)) at L403-L406 and only tests MaxAbsEta > EtaBlowVal at L409. A NaN elevation need not satisfy that ordered comparison, so the numerical-failure check has no explicit finite/NaN guard before normal execution continues.

SHAPIRO_3 requires at least three halo cells because L499-L504 and L519-L524 access offsets through +/-3, but the loops are bounded merely by Nghost at L495-L496 and L515-L516 and never enforce Nghost>=3. Smaller Nghost values produce out-of-range accesses.
